what: the model a behaviour-exact rebuild needs, derived from the byte-exact corpus: where each global lives, one merged definition per record, and the conflicts left for a person
caveats: far/near divergence is NOT in here: it is an addressing mode with no semantic, required for byte-exactness and meaningless without it
width_conflicts are real behaviour: a byte view of a word is something the program does, and the consumer must express it as a cast at the site
a record whose body this could not parse contributes nothing rather than a guess
